budget: Existing functional/perceptual budget; preserve raw differences and require progression/save integrity and measured benefit.

Of 9600 frames, one earlier top hash at 2026 and one bottom hash at 3188 differ; both pairs remain unmatched within eight neighboring frames. Sampled full-resolution home/town views retain terrain, buildings, player, NPCs and menus. Raw RAM/audio/timing differences retained; not full-run bit-exactness or human approval. Functional-budget native qualification required.

validated.scope: New Bark Town, home and Bag only. No independent regional new-game progression, battle/whole-game or human audiovisual approval. Persistent core save states unsupported.

gain.scope: Two 30-second verified cold-start windows per arm at stock 1 GHz, pooled using total pairs / total seconds. Initial pair retained; one extra pair predeclared for a borderline result. Publications are not unique animation FPS, cycle counts or whole-game speed. No native decoded-control window or confidence interval claimed.
